name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages an Nginx web tier hosting three virtual sites with TLS, redirects, static content, security headers, logging, firewall configuration, fail2ban, SSH hardening, and network hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, log directory creation, and post-generation configuration adjustments.
